item.title: Ed Gein’s Grave Became A True Crime Attraction
item.description: After Ed Gein died in a Wisconsin psychiatric hospital in 1984, his grave became a target for souvenir hunters and true crime enthusiasts. His gravestone was repeatedly vandalized before being stolen in 2000 and later recovered, leaving his burial site unmarked.
